refund_policy: No refunds after a failed challenge. One-Phase/Classic fee is credited back with the first reward (min $100 profit; processed within 7 business days); Pro fees not credited; only the upgrade difference is creditable on upgraded accounts.
scaling_plan: Hit 10% profit in each of 3 consecutive months → account balance +50%, repeatable up to $5M
ea_bots: allowed (must own the EA; no exploiting platform inefficiencies/latency)
inactivity_rule: No trade placed/closed for 30 consecutive days → account failed (challenge, instant and funded)
notes: Reset available from dashboard at a discount shown in a pop-up (price not published). Copy trading only between your own accounts. Hedging allowed within one account. Add-ons: Swing (news/weekend holding), 90% split, Second Chance (one free reset) on Instant. Pro min reward = 1% of initial balance.
